name: @absolutejs/agent-exchange-provider-conformance
description: OAuth, DPoP, and black-box A2A security conformance checks for Agent Exchange providers.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/agent-exchange --external '@absolutejs/agent-exchange/*' && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && prettier --write --ignore-path /dev/null 'dist/*.d.ts'
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
